decisions.reason: Floor-level shower drainage is the core of the firm's direction and cheap to keep alongside its compatible product families, though it was not visible on the website in 2020–2021 and so remains a low-visibility option.
As the flagship design drainage line that embodies the firm's design-focused strategy, it justifies continued commitment despite no recent website observations.
The sloped shower element fits the accessible, low-profile renovation trend and costs little to keep, but its missing visibility since 2019 makes its value less certain.
The backflow-protected basement drain was a specifically developed product, and rising flood-protection demand keeps its option value high at low holding cost.
The air-admittance valve is a peripheral accessory with little evidence of traction, but it is cheap to keep and rounds out the system offering, so it stays for now at elevated risk.
